fact_previews: Travel Planner V3 is a budget-oriented tool designed to help travelers plan, budget, save, and share their travel configurations.
Travel Planner V3 is built in Microsoft Excel as a macro-enabled workbook.
The tool aims to simplify the process of planning trips by storing all supporting travel information in a single, unified tool.
The application is currently being developed for Canadians with CAD pricing.
If funding is complete, a USA version of Travel Planner V3 will be developed with USD pricing.
